# Day06 code provenance

The four modules in `day06/` are copied unchanged from the user's Day06 repository:
https://github.com/TrnhThnh/K5-L3B-Day06-2A202603907-DataIngestionEngineering

Commit: `bf21bc0b5d7ab8a7ae4902c0905da5dfabd3469c`.
They preserve the Day06 paragraph chunk IDs, 384-dimensional Sentence Transformers
embedding adapter and PostgreSQL `day6_chunks` schema. Day07 reads strategy B;
its optional rebuild writes only a separate `DAY7_B` strategy.

`data/day06/` contains the original pages, question labels and permission manifest.
